escenas.prompt: Emma and Lily cook together at the kitchen island on Thanksgiving afternoon.
The house on a hot, sunny Florida afternoon.
The hallway smart thermostat notices the kitchen heating up.
Emma, behind the island, checks the alert on her phone and taps it.
The thermostat ring glows cool blue: the AC starts cooling.
Emma and Lily sit down to eat together at the island, relaxed.

partes.texto: Oven on since noon. So why isn't it hot?
The thermostat feels the heat building,
and pings Mom. One tap, mid-recipe.
The AC eases on before anyone sweats.
The turkey's hot. The house isn't. Happy Thanksgiving.
